figures.caption: Fig. 1: The observed closed loop cost Jobs for each patient is denoted by an orange dot. The blue dots denote the 10 closed-loop MPC costs (JMPC), and the light gray bar spans their range for each patient. The green diamonds denote the median closed-loop MPC cost for each patient.

Fig. 2: Observed course versus the closed-loop MPC simulations for two sampled patients. The top panel in each illustrates the remission at each event and the bottom panel shows the input sequence over time. The abbreviations in the figure are as follows: vedolizumab (VDZ), ustekinumab (UST), tofacitinib (TOF), and infliximab (IFX).
